description: This file defines the PersistentStreamProvider class and related enums for managing persistent streams within the Orleans framework. It includes command enums, class constructor, lifecycle management, stream retrieval, and command execution logic.

classes.name: PersistentStreamProvider
classes.description: Implements a persistent stream provider for Orleans, responsible for managing streams, lifecycle, and commands.

classes.name: PersistentStreamProviderCommand
classes.description: Enumeration of commands that can be handled by PersistentStreamProvider, such as starting/stopping agents and retrieving agent states.

methods.name: PersistentStreamProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream provider with dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the provider, setting up the adapter factory and stream subscription manager.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the provider's agents if applicable and updates the state.

methods.name: GetStreamSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Returns the stream subscription manager used by this provider.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down the provider and its pulling agent manager.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a stream for a given StreamId.

methods.name: GetProducerInterface
methods.description: Provides the producer interface for a stream, for publishing messages.

methods.name: GetConsumerInterface
methods.description: Provides the consumer interface for a stream, for subscribing to messages.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands on the provider or its components based on command code.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the provider to lifecycle events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a PersistentStreamProvider.

methods.name: ParticipateIn
methods.description: Convenience method for participating in a specific lifecycle.

methods.name: LogWarningGotCommand
methods.description: Logs a warning when an uninitialized command is received.

calls: new StreamConsumer<T>((StreamImpl<T>)stream, Name, this.runtime, this.runtime.PubSub(this.pubsubOptions.PubSubType), this.logger, IsRewindable)
